title: 奇症略述 / Qi zheng lue shu [Brief accounts of remarkable cases]: Bodleian Sinica 1784 transcription dataset
publication_state: GitHub release package; no version DOI assigned at packaging

descriptions.text: 《奇症略述》(Qi zheng lue shu；編者英譯 Brief accounts of remarkable cases)是嘉約翰(John Glasgow Kerr)與廣州(Canton)博濟醫局相關的病例及院務文獻。書中收結石、腫瘤等病例及圖說，並有院務徵信、收支、施醫統計、會務及出版記事，可供晚清醫學史、醫療傳教、醫學翻譯、慈善機構與醫學圖像傳播史研究。館目年代1864–1868與本藏1866、1868刊記、1869年序及1873年附錄分別保留，不推為同一刊刻年。本版提供91個原印面的JSON、TXT與TEI、逐單位原件來源定位、疑讀紀錄及另層連讀檔。AI輔助轉錄；舊60面保留獨立AI讀稿比對與原圖複核，新增31面以本藏初錄為主，部分數字經原圖複核。疑讀已標，未經專家審定。 本版就兩底本對照表的數字差異回查原圖，修訂 29 個單元。收錄範圍與上一版相同。

Qi zheng lue shu (editorial translation: Brief accounts of remarkable cases) contains case records and institutional documents associated with John Glasgow Kerr and the Medical Missionary Society hospital at Canton (Guangzhou). It includes cases and captions concerning stones, tumours and other conditions, together with hospital reports, accounts, attendance figures, organizational business and publishing notices. It supports histories of medicine, medical missions, translation, charity and medical illustration. The catalogue date 1864–1868 is recorded separately from imprints dated 1866 and 1868, a preface dated 1869 and an appendix dated 1873. This version provides JSON, TXT and TEI for 91 original printed faces, unit-level links to the source, uncertainty records and a separately labelled readable derivative. The transcription is AI-assisted: the earlier 60 faces retain independent AI reading comparison and image review; the added 31 faces mainly retain an initial transcription, with targeted image checks of figures. Uncertain readings remain marked; expert review has not been performed. This release checks disputed readings from a cross-copy comparison against the original scan and corrects 29 units. The edition covers the same 91 printed faces.
